purpose: Personal activity intelligence derived from the current user's audit-log feed, separate from the admin-wide audit view.
primaryGoal: Understand which actions I took, when I took them, their categories and affected entities, and navigate to supported entity destinations.

dataSources.name: Personal audit activity
dataSources.queryBehavior: Key ['users','me','activity',params]; forwards AbortSignal; safeArray select; STALE_TIMES.STANDARD. Page does not pass offset.
dataSources.payload: UserActivityEntry[]: id, ts, action, entity_type, entity_id, detail, ip, user_agent; snake_case is canonical.
dataSources.backendOwnership: auditHandler.UserActivity, confirmed only by the route registration; handler/repository filtering and ordering were not inspected.
dataSources.limits: All six displayed sections use the same loaded payload, capped by the page at 200 entries. These are not full-range server aggregates or account-lifetime totals.

dataSources.name: Range and local derivations
dataSources.behavior: Page uses start/end URL keys and my-activity.range preference; derives four count KPIs, latest timestamp, inclusive gap-filled daily counts (366-day cap), top six action slices, top eight category slices and all 24 local-hour buckets. No additional endpoint or physical-unit conversion.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.role: Full-width container adapter and existing page header/freshness pipeline.

components.name: DataStateNotice / ErrorDisplay / StaleRefreshWarning
components.role: Unsupported identity deployment, authentication failure, retained-data refresh/offline warning.

components.name: GlassPanel / PanelTitle
components.role: Existing panel surface and title; do not introduce a new card library.

components.name: FadeIn
components.role: Four content bands plus gated notice entrance; implementation/reduced-motion behavior not inspected.

components.name: MyActivityKpiBand / SystemSummaryBrief / OperationalBrief
components.role: Existing raw-count bridge; preserves missing versus zero and source-limited scope.

components.name: ActivityTrendPanel / ActivityHourPanel / EmbeddedChart
components.role: Existing chart-barrel frames, tooltips, axes, numeric counts and dataColumns alternatives.

components.name: ActivityBreakdownPanel / MetricBar
components.role: Already reused for top actions and categories, with localized count/percentage readouts.

components.name: ActivityFeedPanel / RecentActivityFeed / Timeline
components.role: Retains input ordering, action icons/labels, entity metadata/details, relative timestamps, and encoded entity links.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Top actions and categories already share one typed renderer; this is intentional reuse, not a second implementation.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain this owner and both call sites.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Each panel repeats loading/error/empty/retry props from the same source. Chart panels share panel/title/bar-chart structure but use different data and accessible descriptions.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse the current chart and feedback owners; only factor a small feature-local state-props adapter if useful. No new universal panel/query-state engine is justified by this page.

sourceBehavior: Trend/top-action band stacks until xl, then uses three columns with trend spanning two: MyActivityPage.tsx:119-124.
Category/hour band stacks below md and uses two columns from md: MyActivityPage.tsx:148-151.
Panels use p-4 sm:p-5 and charts ResponsiveContainer: ActivityTrendPanel.tsx:80,103; ActivityHourPanel.tsx:58,83.
Timeline titles/times wrap with min-w-0 and break-words: Timeline.tsx:132-141.

issues.detail: Subtitle includes raw entity IDs/details but has no explicit break-words/overflow-wrap treatment, unlike the title and timestamp. Long unbroken details are a source-level overflow risk.
issues.fix: Use the existing semantic text role with safe wrapping without truncating entity details; validate narrow containers and 200% text.

responsive.status: Source reflow inspected only; no viewport, clipping, touch-target or visual acceptance.

sourceBehavior: Two named section landmarks and aria-hidden decorative header icons: MyActivityPage.tsx:119-154.
Trend and hour charts supply ariaLabel and explicit dataColumns to EmbeddedChart; actual rendered alternative UI was not exercised.
Feed loading uses role=status, aria-busy and localized aria-label: ActivityFeedPanel.tsx:51-57.
Breakdown loading uses VisuallyHidden liveRegion and named MetricBar progressbars: ActivityBreakdownPanel.tsx:66-69; MetricBar.tsx:56-61.
Timeline uses a named ordered list and hidden summary: Timeline.tsx:92-97.

issues.detail: Entity links remove their focus outline and rely on focus underline. Source does not establish that this is a sufficiently visible focus indicator on composed backgrounds.
issues.fix: Use the existing semantic link/focus tokens with a clear focus-visible outline; retain native Link navigation and localized titles.

states.initialLoading: KPI bridge suppresses unavailable readings; each panel has skeleton/chart-frame loading. PageLayout is given query metadata, not a page-wide loading replacement.
states.empty: Zero-length resolved payload renders count-zero KPI values with missing last-active, chart/list empty states and feed EmptyState. Counts refer only to the successfully loaded subset.
states.fatalError: state.fatalError drives sectionIsError and retries; initial 503 gets an unsupported ForwardAuth explanation, initial 401 gets ErrorDisplay.
states.retainedRefresh: Ordinary refresh errors retain data via useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning. KPI receives available/retained flags.
states.offline: StaleRefreshWarning uses isRefreshBlocked to render an offline explanation for retained data; initial offline-paused panel behavior remains runtime-unverified.

issues.rule: MDC-026 retained data must survive refresh failure
issues.detail: hardGate reads raw query.error status (401/503), not state.fatalError. A background 503 after successful load takes the full gate branch at line 90 and removes all six retained sections even though state.hasData remains true.
issues.fix: Derive the unsupported gate from fatal/no-retained-data state; retain data plus the existing warning on deployment-unavailable refresh. Preserve explicit authentication policy rather than assuming authorization failures should expose data.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed text-cyan-300 accents decorate unrelated top-action/category headings; similar fixed cyan icons occur in each feature panel. These are source-level theme/noise concerns, not measured contrast failures.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted/secondary semantic icon tokens for structural headings; keep meaningful action/severity cues and persisted user chart colors.

visualIssues.rule: Mission 43 / MDC-010 avoid rainbow saturation and decorative gradients
visualIssues.detail: Ranked slices cycle chartTokens.series by rank (analytics lines 200/216), including saturated pink/lime. MetricBar defaults to gradient (MetricBar.tsx:45,86). Rank does not establish semantic color meaning.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing MetricBar fill='solid' and restrained caller-prepared theme colors for ranked lists without changing count, percentage, max, sort or labels. Keep chart-series ownership centralized.

visualIssues.detail: The feed's vehicle-command fallback uses text-fuchsia-400, among many fixed-color action glyphs. The source confirms saturated decoration; no rendered fluorescence or contrast is claimed.
visualIssues.fix: Have the existing action-visual registry owner review semantic token mapping; preserve every action mapping, i18n key, icon and prefix fallback.

architectureIssues.detail: Route is range-enabled at workspaceScope.ts:51, but explicit start/end URL keys disable headerOwned in useRangeState.ts:301-302. The shared hook has a change-event handoff for custom keys, so this is not proof that every header interaction fails; canonical from/to deep-link/default ownership remains inconsistent.
architectureIssues.fix: Consume the canonical header-owned range; preserve existing bookmarked start/end links through an explicit integration transition rather than silently deleting their semantics.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-032 full instant bounds and timezone semantics
architectureIssues.detail: Only calendar start/end reach the hook, whose parameter interface at useUser.ts:46-64 has no instant/exclusive-end fields. useRangeState exposes precise rolling instants at lines 661-662, but these are discarded here. The page cannot express a precise 24-hour window with its current date-only request.
architectureIssues.fix: Extend the existing typed hook/endpoint contract to carry both instant bounds when the server supports them; keep raw entry cache shape, query cancellation and inherited policies. Backend bound semantics need owner verification, not guessed support.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-044 consistent timezone and scope explanations
architectureIssues.detail: Daily grouping calls ymdInTz(date) without an explicit timezone and hourly grouping uses browser-local getHours(). No range timezone is passed to this derivation. Selected timezone parity is unverified, and daily trend silently caps at 366 days while other breakdowns use the loaded payload.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve existing local-hour behavior while checking the formatting/timezone owner's policy; pass the resolved workspace timezone if required and explain the 366-day trend cap without deleting any other loaded-data section.

order: Correct retained-data gate and clarify authentication policy.
Integrate canonical workspace range and exact server-bound semantics.
Preserve all six views and loaded-subset explanation.
Adopt restrained existing presentation props/tokens and improve shared link focus/wrapping.
Run centralized browser/accessibility acceptance after implementation.

dependsOn: Existing backend date-filter semantics must be verified
requiredSharedChanges.scope: Integration extension of existing owner, not a new query/range implementation.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing RecentActivityFeed native link focus
requiredSharedChanges.scope: Repair current owner; no new link/navigation component.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing Timeline subtitle wrapping
dependsOn: Existing typography roles and wrapping utilities
requiredSharedChanges.scope: No truncation, metadata removal or reordering.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing activity action-visual registry restraint
requiredSharedChanges.scope: Owner review, not speculative global palette replacement.

competingImplementations.detail: Custom page URL keys/preference coexist with the canonical header-owned range, despite the registered dated route.
competingImplementations.fix: Consolidate through useRangeState and the existing endpoint integration; do not add a local date picker.

preservation.lineCountScope: Page plus seven non-test source files in components\my-activity, including analytics and barrel; shared SystemSummaryBrief is not included.

sections.name: Activity summary
sections.content: Total actions, active days, action types, entities touched, last-active relative timestamp; source availability/retention and loaded-limit scope.

sections.name: Activity over time
sections.content: Gap-filled daily bar chart, integer counts, day labels, tooltip and dataColumns.

sections.name: Top actions
sections.content: Top six counts/percentages with translated registry labels and ranked bars.

sections.name: By category
sections.content: Top eight category counts/percentages, humanized labels and System / other fallback.

sections.name: By hour of day
sections.content: All 24 local-hour buckets, integer-count chart and dataColumns.

sections.name: Activity feed
sections.content: Every loaded row in source order, action identity, entity type/id, detail and relative timestamp; supported entity links.

actions: Retry/refetch the existing activity query through each section error handler: MyActivityPage.tsx:73-75.
Refresh retained data through StaleRefreshWarning's existing retry button: StaleRefreshWarning.tsx:107-121.
Navigate to encoded /vehicles/:id, /drives/:id and /charging/:id entity paths.
Navigate alert_rule to /notifications/inbox, automation to /automations, geofence to /geofences, data_export/export to /data-export and api_key to /api-keys: RecentActivityFeed.tsx:35-57.
Retain shared chart-frame tooltips/data alternatives and any inherited controls; frame implementation and runtime action availability were not inspected.
Retain shared PageContainer subtitle help and source freshness metadata; page does not opt into copy-link or page-level export.
dataBehavior: One authenticated user-scoped endpoint, no new admin feed or invented aggregate endpoint.
Preserve raw payload fields/cache keys, AbortSignal, safeArray selection, limits and inherited query policies.
Maintain loaded-subset wording and maximum-200 qualifier; do not rename subset counts as full-range totals.
Preserve genuine resolved zero counts, missing last timestamp and unavailable readings as distinct states.
Retain four numeric counts and one timestamp metric, all derivations, 366-day guard, top-action/category caps and 24-hour buckets.
Retain existing sorting/tie behavior, null/blank action/entity handling and source feed ordering.
Preserve identity deployment/401 messaging and authorization boundaries while correcting the 503 retained-data regression.
No physical SI fields are transformed or introduced; retain unknown backend semantics explicitly.
preservation.verification: Get-FileHash before inspection and before report returned the same SHA256; final release validation rechecks it.

evidenceLimits.lintTypecheckBuildTests: NOTRUN: assignment prohibits project validation/source edits; audit.sh was inspected but not executed because it unconditionally runs project TypeScript.
evidenceLimits.routeReachability: Assigned route retained exactly; workspace range registration and API registration inspected. Router mount/authenticated browser access not exercised.
evidenceLimits.backend: Only the endpoint registration was inspected. Inclusive/exclusive filtering, timezone interpretation, identity enforcement, ordering and database behavior are not certified.
evidenceLimits.sharedScope: Only direct page-specific rendering/trust/range owners inspected; broad shell/theme/catalog audits are outside this task.

sourceChecks.command: PowerShell Select-String over the page and seven non-test my-activity source files for style=, <(button|input|textarea|select|table)\b, text-white|text-neon|glow; Get-Content line counts; Get-FileHash page -Algorithm SHA256
sourceChecks.qualification: Counts are scoped literal/pattern checks, not a complete violations audit or proof of absence of inherited neon/glow/pure-white styling. Saturated/gradient dependencies are reported separately.
sourceChecks.failedProbe: One initial PowerShell citation/count probe exited 1 with ParserError (quote escaping); it was corrected and rerun successfully without any file writes.
